pages.title: Princess Zelda in Her Royal Gown and Tiara Holding the Triforce of Wisdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda holds the Triforce of Wisdom in this printable coloring page, wearing her royal gown and tiara with long hair flowing behind her shoulders. Triangular earrings, decorated cuffs, and an ornate front gown panel add small sections beside the wide skirt, while distant castle towers rise beyond the terrace.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Swimming Up Stacked Water Block Echoes From Echoes of Wisdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Princess Zelda swimming up stacked Water Block Echoes from Echoes of Wisdom, reaching one hand upward as bubbles surround her flowing hair. Three rounded water blocks create broad transparent-looking sections, while her jeweled headband, necklace, belt, and patterned gown panel add smaller enclosed details.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Rescuing Tri's Friends on the Floating Islands of the Still World from Echoes of Wisdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda rescues Tri's friends on the Still World's floating islands in this printable coloring page, holding one small companion while two others hover nearby. Her braided crown, flowing cape, and patterned gown add detail around the figures, while fractured island edges, clouds, and ruined columns fill the surrounding scene.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Disguised as Sheik Playing the Harp From Ocarina of Time Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Princess Zelda disguised as Sheik playing a harp from Ocarina of Time, wearing a wrapped head covering and cloth face mask. The chest eye emblem, bandaged forearms, and harp's curled frame provide smaller sections, while fitted clothing and long fabric ties create broader enclosed shapes.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Trapped Inside a Crystal in Ganondorf's Castle From Ocarina of Time Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda is trapped inside a crystal in Ganondorf's Castle in this printable coloring page, pressing both open hands outward within the tall faceted enclosure. Her tiara and decorated gown panel add fine details to the Ocarina of Time scene, while the crystal's stone base and surrounding columns provide larger geometric sections.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Trapped in Yuga's Painting From a Link Between Worlds Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Princess Zelda trapped in Yuga's painting from A Link Between Worlds, with clasped hands inside a tall decorative picture frame. Curled leaves, diamond ornaments, and a Triforce crest surround the portrait, while the gown's front emblem, flowing hair, and long sleeve folds create distinct coloring sections.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Giving Link a Shield at the Picori Festival From the Minish Cap Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda gives Link a shield at the Picori Festival in this printable coloring page, with both characters holding the small shield beneath hanging triangular pennants. Vertical plank lines and round studs detail the shield, while Zelda's long gown, jeweled headpiece, and Link's pointed cap and boots provide broader coloring areas.

pages.title: Princess Zelda in Her Battle Armor Wielding a Rapier From Hyrule Warriors Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Princess Zelda wielding a rapier in her Hyrule Warriors battle armor, with one arm extended beneath long hair and braided front sections. Decorated shoulder plates, fitted bracers, and tall armored boots add small enclosed patterns, while the flowing skirt panels provide broader areas around the slender blade.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Giving Peace Sign in Modern Outfit Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda gives a peace sign in this printable coloring page, winking in a modern crop top, pleated skirt, fishnet stockings, and a chain-trimmed belt. Her braided headband, pointed ears, and Triforce pendant connect the casual outfit to the character. Small sparkles surround the figure, with finer details concentrated in the jewelry, chain links, and stocking pattern.

pages.title: Princess Zelda with High Ponytail Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page presents Princess Zelda with a high ponytail, looking back over her shoulder with wide eyes, pointed ears, and a small open mouth. A braid curves over her head above a triangular forehead ornament. Large sweeping hair sections dominate the coloring sheet, with tiny ear cuffs and several outlined sparkles providing smaller details nearby.

pages.title: Chibi Princess Zelda Sitting in Hoodie Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Princess Zelda sits with her knees raised in this printable coloring page, wearing an oversized hoodie with dangling drawstrings, loose trousers, and large rounded cuffs. Her pointed ears, braided hair, and sleepy eyes remain clearly visible above the hood. Bold contours leave spacious clothing sections around the small geometric design on the front of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Making Hand Heart Gesture Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda makes a hand-heart gesture in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath a braided headband and jeweled forehead ornament while hearts surround her pointed ears. An outlined heart fills the space between her hands. Decorative shoulder pieces and geometric clothing patterns add smaller sections below the expressive portrait, with radiating lines accenting the central pose.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Cheerful Smile Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page presents Princess Zelda in a cheerful smile portrait, with pointed ears, braided hair, a round choker ornament, and a patterned belt below. Her wide grin and large eyes dominate the close-up figure. Small sparkles float beside the head, while geometric clothing details add smaller sections around the broad face and hair areas.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Smiling in Hooded Cloak Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda smiles in a hooded cloak in this printable coloring page, lifting a hand near her hair with braided sections and pointed ears framing the face. Angular trim borders the broad cloak and shoulder pieces. The coloring sheet focuses on the portrait and draped clothing, with a small outlined heart and fine costume lines providing additional details.

pages.title: Anime Elf Princess Zelda in Maid Outfit Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows anime elf Princess Zelda in a maid outfit, wearing a ruffled headband, a collared apron dress, puff sleeves, and small hair bows. One hand rests across her chest as she stands beside a leafy potted plant. The coloring sheet mixes broad apron folds with smaller buttons, pointed ears, and frilled clothing edges.

pages.title: Chibi Princess Zelda in Armor Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Princess Zelda wears armor in this printable coloring page, with a patterned chest plate, decorative belt, wide wrist guards, and long hair streaming beside her. Her pointed ears and braided headband frame the small smile. Angular floating shapes echo the geometric armor motifs, while the flowing cloth sections provide broader spaces throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Wearing Tiara and Triforce Earrings Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page portrays Princess Zelda wearing an ornate tiara and Triforce earrings, turning over one shoulder with a hand raised near her chin. Long hair sweeps behind the fitted sleeveless dress. A hanging waist ornament and vertical background lines add smaller details, balancing the broad hair sections and open clothing panels on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Zelda in Hyrule Castle Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda stands in Hyrule Castle courtyard in this printable coloring page, folding her hands over an ornate gown beneath a tiara with a triangular emblem. Layered shoulder pieces, patterned cuffs, a necklace, castle towers, and a lamppost provide fine details on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Zelda on Death Mountain Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda stands on Death Mountain in this printable coloring page, folding her hands over a patterned travel outfit with shoulder armor and a long cloak. A winding mountain trail, rocky slopes, a distant castle, and a crescent moon create the landscape on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Zelda in Master Sword Grove Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda rests both hands on the Master Sword in this printable coloring page, standing behind its carved stone pedestal beneath the branches of Master Sword Grove. Triangular emblems, exposed roots, falling leaves, and small flowers frame the peaceful woodland scene on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Zelda in Hyrule Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda appears at Hyrule Castle in this printable coloring page, wearing a beaded tiara, drop earrings, and a necklace above a gown with a winged chest emblem. An ornamental arch, small balcony, flags, and many pointed towers surround her portrait on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Zelda in Goron City Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda visits Goron City in this printable coloring page, shown with a braided crown hairstyle, forehead jewel, patterned armor, and a gentle smile above folded hands. A pottery stall, steaming rocky opening, and large carved face fill the background on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.
